scope: preliminary verse-specific screening; not full comparative source verification
methodology: Read and classified verse meanings individually; proposed two conservative locator-only leads based on familiar biblical passages; neither primary text nor critical edition was fetched during this session. Do not infer dependence or claim verified source checks.

verses.summary: Believers commanded to take precautions and advance in groups or together
Reluctant participant delays and calls absence from fighting a favor
After others' success, reluctant participant regrets missing material gain
Those trading worldly life for hereafter are exhorted to fight; reward promised
Appeal to fight for oppressed men, women and children seeking deliverance
Believers fight in God's cause, opponents in cause of taghut; exhortation
Earlier restraint and prayer/almsgiving contrasted with fear when fighting commanded
Death reaches people even in fortified towers; good and evil attributed in disputation
Good is from God, misfortune attributed to oneself; messenger sent as witness
Obedience to messenger linked to obedience to God; no guardianship over rejecters

staged_candidates.relationship: possible contrast, reluctance and danger of conflict
staged_candidates.similarity: Both passages portray reluctance toward dangerous communal action.
staged_candidates.difference: Numbers concerns Israelites fearing entry into Canaan and proposing return to Egypt; Qur'an 4:77 concerns people who previously sought fighting but fear a newly prescribed obligation.
staged_candidates.verification: Locator-only lead; primary original and critical translation NOT inspected in this session; do not publish.

staged_candidates.similarity: Human beings cannot evade the arrival of death or calamity.
staged_candidates.difference: Ecclesiastes describes unpredictable mortal fate through figurative imagery, not the Qur'anic claim about death reaching people in fortified towers.
staged_candidates.verification: Locator-only lead; Hebrew text, edition and witnesses NOT inspected; do not publish.
